'''Ki no Ushi''' (紀 大人) was a figure of the {{ill|Asuka period|ar|فترة أسوكا|be|Перыяд Асука|bg|Асука|bn|আসুকা যুগ|ca|Període Asuka|cs|Období Asuka|de|Asuka-Zeit|eo|Asuka-epoko|es|Período Asuka|eu|Asuka aroa|fa|دوره آسوکا|fi|Asuka-kausi|fr|Période d'Asuka|he|תקופת אסוקה|hr|Asuka (razdoblje)|hu|Aszuka-kor|id|Zaman Asuka|it|Periodo Asuka|ja|飛鳥時代|ko|아스카 시대|lt|Asuka laikotarpis|ms|Zaman Asuka|nl|Asukaperiode|nn|Asuka|no|Asuka|pl|Asuka (okres)|pt|Período Asuka|ru|Период Асука|sh|Asuka period|simple|Asuka period|sk|Obdobie Asuka|sl|Obdobje Asuka|sq|Periudha Asuka|sr|Асука период|sv|Asuka|th|ยุคอาซูกะ|tl|Panahong Asuka|tr|Asuka Dönemi|uk|Період Асука|vi|Thời kỳ Asuka|zh|飛鳥時代|zh_classical|飛鳥時代|zh_min_nan|Asuka sî-tāi|zh_yue|飛鳥時代|qid=Q210688|lt=Asuka period}}. His hereditary title was initially {{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|qid=Q2574718|lt=Omi}}, later changed to {{ill|Ason|en|Ason|qid=Q4807592|lt=Ason}}. He was the son of {{ill|Ki no Ōkuchi|ja|紀大口|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ki no Ōguchi|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q98083044}}. His Rank was {{ill|Dai Kinge|ja|大錦下|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dai Kinshita|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11439798}}・{{ill|yushi dafu|ja|御史大夫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Omatsurigoto no Futo|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11071155}}, and he was posthumously awarded the Rank of {{ill|Jushii|ja|正三位|1=Senior Third Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jushii|13=User:Immanuelle/Senior Third Rank}}.

During the {{ill|Jinshin War|en|Jinshin War|qid=Q2378252|lt=Jinshin War}} of {{ill|672|en|672|qid=Q30601|lt=672}}, he served as a senior retainer on the side of {{ill|Emperor Kōbun|en|Emperor Kōbun|qid=Q357242|lt=Prince Ōtomo}} but was not punished after the conflict.

== Career ==

In the 10th year of {{ill|Emperor Tenji|en|Emperor Tenji|qid=Q314802|lt=Emperor Tenji}} ({{ill|671|en|671|qid=Q30722|lt=671}}), on January 5, {{ill|Emperor Kōbun|en|Emperor Kōbun|qid=Q357242|lt=Prince Ōtomo}} (later {{ill|Emperor Kōbun|en|Emperor Kōbun|qid=Q357242|lt=Emperor Kōbun}}) was appointed {{ill|Daijō-daijin|en|Daijō-daijin|qid=Q1157586|lt=Daijō-daijin}}; {{ill|Soga no Akae|ja|蘇我赤兄|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Soga no Akae|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11625208}} became {{ill|Minister of the Left|en|Minister of the Left|qid=Q949008|lt=Minister of the Left}}; {{ill|Nakatomi no Kane|ja|中臣金|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nakatomi no Kane|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11366917}} was appointed {{ill|Minister of the Right|en|Minister of the Right|qid=Q1351174|lt=Udaijin}}; and {{ill|Hatayasu Soga|ja|蘇我果安|qid=Q11625201}}, {{ill|Kose no Hito|ja|巨勢人|qid=Q11479766}}, and Ki no Ushi were appointed {{ill|yushi dafu|ja|御史大夫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Omatsurigoto no Futo|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11071155}}.

On November 23, Prince Ōtomo, along with the aforementioned ministers, swore to uphold the "Emperor's decree" in the western palace hall before a Buddha image woven from textiles. Prince Ōtomo took the incense burner, declaring, "I uphold the Emperor's decree. If I deviate from it, I shall be punished by divine retribution." Following this, the five ministers each swore to support the decree, invoking the protection of the {{ill|Four Heavenly Kings|as|চাৰিজন স্বৰ্গীয় ৰজা|bxr|Дүрбэн махаранза|cs|Čtyři nebeští králové|es|Cuatro reyes celestiales|et|Maailmakaitsja|fr|Quatre Rois célestes|id|Catur Maharaja Kayika|ja|四天王|ko|사천왕|lt|Čaturmaharadža|ms|Empat Maharaja Langit|my|စတုမဟာရာဇ်နတ်မင်းကြီးလေးပါး|new|चतुर्महाराज|nl|Vier Hemelse Koningen|ro|Cei patru regi cerești|ru|Четыре Небесных Царя|si|සතරවරම් දෙවිවරු|simple|Four Heavenly Kings|sl|Čhatumaharadžika|ta|சதுர்மகாராசாக்கள்|th|จาตุมหาราชิกา|tl|Apat na Hari sa Langit|tr|Dört Göksel Kral|uk|Чотири небесні королі|vi|Thiên vương|zh|四大天王|zh_yue|四大天王|qid=Q1068367|lt=Four Heavenly Kings}} and the divine punishment of the {{ill|kami|ja|天神地祇|lt=Tenjin Chigi}} if they betrayed the oath. The specifics of the "Emperor's decree" are unclear, but it is believed to have involved the succession of Prince Ōtomo after {{ill|Emperor Tenji|en|Emperor Tenji|qid=Q314802|lt=Emperor Tenji}}'s passing. On the 29th, they reaffirmed this oath before Emperor Tenji, likely repeating the earlier pledge.

After Emperor Tenji's death, Ki no Ushi became a key retainer supporting Prince Ōtomo. However, the {{ill|Nihon Shoki|en|Nihon Shoki|qid=Q813935|lt=Nihon Shoki}} does not mention his activities during the ensuing Jinshin War. According to the {{ill|Shoku Nihongi|en|Shoku Nihongi|qid=Q611399|lt=Shoku Nihongi}}, an entry dated {{ill|Keiun|ar|فترة كيون|de|Keiun|es|Keiun|fa|کیوئون|fr|Ère Keiun|ia|Keiun|id|Keiun|ja|慶雲|ko|게이운|ru|Кэйун|simple|Keiun|sr|Кеиун|th|เคอุง|tr|Keiun|uk|Кей'ун|zh|慶雲 (日本)|zh_yue|慶雲 (日本)|qid=Q428753|lt=Keiun}} 2 ({{ill|705|ab|705|af|705|am|705 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|705|ar|705|ary|705|ast|705|az|705|azb|۷۰۵ (میلادی)|bar|705|be|705|be_x_old|705|bg|705|bn|৭০৫|bpy|মারি ৭০৫|br|705|bs|705.|ca|705|cdo|705 nièng|ceb|705|ckb|٧٠٥|crh|705|cs|705|cv|705|cy|705|da|705|de|705|el|705|eml|705|eo|705|es|705|et|705|eu|705|fa|۷۰۵ (میلادی)|fi|705|fo|705|fr|705|fy|705|ga|705|gan|705年|gd|705|gl|705|hak|705-ngièn|he|705|hi|705|hr|705.|ht|705 (almanak jilyen)|hu|705|hy|705|id|705|ilo|705|io|705|is|705|it|705|ja|705年|jv|705|ka|705|kaa|705|kk|705 жыл|ko|705년|la|705|lb|705|lij|705|lmo|705|lt|705 m.|map_bms|705|mdf|705|mg|705|mhr|705|mk|705|mr|इ.स. ७०५|mrj|705 и|ms|705|mzn|۷۰۵|nah|705|nap|705|nds|705|new|सन् ७०५|nl|705|nn|705|no|705|nrm|705|nso|705|oc|705|or|୭୦୫|os|705-æм аз|pl|705|pnb|705|pt|705|qu|705|ro|705|ru|705 год|rue|705|sa|७०५|sah|705|scn|705|sd|705ع|sh|705.|shn|705|si|705|simple|705|sk|705|sl|705|sq|705|sr|705|su|705|sv|705|sw|705|tg|Соли 705|th|พ.ศ. 1248|tk|705|tl|705|tly|705|tr|705|tt|705 ел|uk|705|ur|705ء|uz|705|vec|705|vi|705|war|705|wuu|705年|xmf|705|zh|705年|zh_min_nan|705 nî|zh_yue|705年|qid=Q23504|lt=705}}) mentions that {{ill|Ki no Maro|ja|紀麻呂|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ki no Maro|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11605127}} was the "son of Ki no Ushi, {{ill|yushi dafu|ja|御史大夫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Omatsurigoto no Futo|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11071155}} of the Ōmi Court, posthumously awarded {{ill|Jushii|ja|正三位|1=Senior Third Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jushii|13=User:Immanuelle/Senior Third Rank}}." This suggests that Ushi was not treated as a criminal after the war, unlike others such as Soga no Kayasu and Prince Ōtomo, who committed suicide, and Nakatomi no Kane, who was executed. Soga no Akae and Kose no Hito were exiled.

The reasons for Ki no Ushi's pardon are unknown, but hypotheses include intervention by his kinsman {{ill|Q11605114|ja|紀阿閉麻呂|qid=Q11605114}}, defection to {{ill|Emperor Tenmu|ja|大海人皇子|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Prince Ōama|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天武天皇|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q335181}} (later {{ill|Emperor Tenmu|2=ja|3=天武天皇|ja|Emperor Tenmu|2=ja|3=天武天皇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Emperor Tenmu|13=User:Immanuelle/Emperor Tenmu|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q335181}}), or secret negotiations.

The {{ill|Shoku Nihongi|en|Shoku Nihongi|qid=Q611399|lt=Shoku Nihongi}} implies that he retired from public service after his tenure as {{ill|yushi dafu|ja|御史大夫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Omatsurigoto no Futo|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11071155}} of the Ōmi Court. His death date is uncertain, but genealogical records indicate he died on Tenmu 12 ({{ill|683|en|683|qid=Q33496|lt=683}}) {{ill|June 2 (Lunisolar)|cdo|6 nguŏk 2 hô̤ (nùng-lĭk)|ja|6月2日 (旧暦)|ko|음력 6월 2일|zh|六月初二|zh_min_nan|6 goe̍h 2 ji̍t (kū-le̍k)|zh_yue|六月初二|qid=Q839684|lt=June 2 (lunar calendar)}}.
